review_note: First-pass labels; a second team member should review before these count as human-labelled.

fields.conversations: conversation files whose drafts are grouped together in one call
fields.same_group: pairs whose drafts must share a group
fields.duplicates: pairs that must be reported as duplicates
fields.not_duplicates: pairs in one group that are paraphrases, not duplicates

cases.name: paraphrases, duplicates and similar-but-different questions
cases.note: G09 gives 30 days where G01 gives 7: same question, incompatible answer. It stays apart for #18 to flag.

cases.name: ABCD out-of-stock back orders

cases.name: ABCD promo codes under different conditions
cases.note: A guest refused (0041), a gold member given a code (0044), a guest given a code (0046) and a system error fixed with a code (0050) are different answers.
